mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner ear sensing tissue was most worthwhile: the bending hairs and changing nerve signals helped explain how movement becomes a message.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hearing pathways to the body felt like a predictable setup step, with the ears still left as outlines.

surprise.text: I wasn't sure how fluid movement reached the hearing cells; the inset showed their tiny hairs bending and signals changing.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The last two connections were the only offered combinations, but their purposes were clear from the pictures.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: following sound from moving air to nerve signals was clear and made me curious about another body process.
